title: Un lead de 200 mil dólares: la comisión que se va por fuera (Serie Sala de Juntas, video 8)

ia.dice: Asesores inmobiliarios: ¿saben cuánto vale uno de estos leads? Un depa de doscientos mil dólares.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, inside a parked car right outside a real estate agency office with a big "AGENCIA INMOBILIARIA" sign. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, shows his phone screen with a luxury apartment listing to the camera, greedy grin, rubs his thumb and fingers together in a money gesture and says in Mexican Spanish, fast and confident, like a mockumentary confession: "Asesores inmobiliarios: ¿saben cuánto vale uno de estos leads? Un depa de doscientos mil dólares." Medium close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, quiet street ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: Compadre, te paso el lead. Tú lo cierras allá y la comisión nos la partimos.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, inside a parked car right outside a real estate agency office with a big "AGENCIA INMOBILIARIA" sign. Rodrigo, a tall thin Mexican real estate agent in his thirties with slicked-back shiny hair, a thin pencil mustache, a shiny grey suit with an open collar and a gold chain, sly smile, holds the phone to his ear, looks left and right to make sure nobody is watching, leans in and says in Mexican Spanish, whispering, conspiratorial: "Compadre, te paso el lead. Tú lo cierras allá y la comisión nos la partimos." Close-up, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

ia.dice: ¿Doscientos leads este mes… y ni una venta? Yo no entiendo qué pasa.
ia.prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Stylized 3D animated cartoon with exaggerated caricature proportions, like a modern animated comedy film. Daytime, a real estate agency owner's office with a big whiteboard that says "VENTAS: 0". Don Ramiro, the owner of a real estate agency, a short chubby Mexican man in his fifties with a thick black mustache, receding hairline, white shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a loose red tie, stands in front of the whiteboard holding a printed leads report, confused, scratches his head and looks at the camera and says in Mexican Spanish, confused and frustrated: "¿Doscientos leads este mes… y ni una venta? Yo no entiendo qué pasa." Medium shot, static camera. Audio: only his voice in Spanish, office ambience. No music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

scenes.text: Haz la cuenta: cada lead que se va por fuera puede ser una venta de cincuenta, cien o doscientos mil dólares. Y esa comisión ya no es para tu inmobiliaria.
